name: Amity: Endless Dream
source:
Tina's life has always been dull. Now that she is in her final year of high school, she seeks to shake things up. With three clubs open and various opportunities before her, Tina will look to leave her mark on Kindred Academy.

However, like with many things, there is something to this school hidden beneath its amicable exterior...
translation:
蒂娜的生活一向平淡无奇。现在她已进入高中最后一年，她寻求改变现状。随着三个俱乐部的开放和各种机会摆在她面前，蒂娜将寻求在Kindred Academy留下自己的印记。

然而，就像许多事情一样，这所学校在其友好的外表下隐藏着一些东西……
